answer: Edge agent economies, such as autonomous harvesters in an orchard, resist Sybil attacks through physical actuation proofs. A candidate node must modulate a calibrated optical lantern while an observer, such as a raven scout drone, records and signs the emission. Attackers must deploy distinct physical hardware for each identity, imposing real manufacturing and power costs. However, this approach cannot protect purely digital tasks and fails during adverse weather occlusions.
